source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check Chassis information and detail information.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes `/redfish/v1/Chassis/OAM_0`, reads only Manufacturer/Model/SerialNumber, bypasses TLS verification, exposes credentials and extrapolates OAM_1~7 without querying or mapping them.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires Chassis enumeration, vendor OAM topology, complete per-member fields, sensitive-value redaction and WebUI correlation; however, once the read-only Project topology package is supplied, no per-action confirmation or manual operation is needed.

old_problem: The eight-index coverage was reduced to one guessed member and three fields. Previous review correctly restored mapping and completeness but left the read-only case in a confirmation-gated class merely because the Project topology was not yet supplied. Topology and expected population are runtime input, not a reason to keep Engineering Decision Pending or require write approval.
disposition_reason: Enumerate the protected Chassis collection, bind actual vendor member IDs to an approved OAM_0 through OAM_7 position matrix, account independently for every expected present or documented unfitted position, capture complete member detail and actual WebUI evidence, and compare to Project BOM/topology. All operations are read-only. The Project mapping is required for readiness and PASS but does not require human confirmation during execution.
decision_basis: XLSX row 949, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 950 were directly reviewed; next pending identity was verified as Functionality row 950 / variant 0a5c189fe49b4e92.
The Items explicitly names OAM_0~7, so all eight logical positions must be accounted independently. `siblings analogous` is not evidence and resource IDs cannot be synthesized from OAM_0.

DMTF Chassis schema defines identity, type, manufacturer/model/part/serial/asset, status, power, location and relationship fields, but OAM naming and position mapping are vendor/Project-specific and must come from the approved topology package.
Absent/unfitted, unsupported, duplicate, omitted, unauthorized and failed member reads have different meanings; the approved population matrix makes each outcome objectively evaluable.
ED-02, ED-21, ED-26 and ED-33 through ED-38 preserve every indexed identity, permit safe parameterization and forbid one-member/template extrapolation or AI-owned DUT verdict.

test_case.test_name: Discover and validate every OAM_0 through OAM_7 chassis position independently
test_case.purpose: Verify that all eight logical OAM positions are independently accounted as approved present or documented unfitted/unsupported states, that every present OAM's complete chassis identity/topology/status/detail is readable and correct in protected Redfish and the actual BMC WebUI, and that no inventory, power or hardware state changes.
required_package: Immutable BMC/SUT/firmware/WebUI identity, trusted TLS chain, protected read-only credential path and sensitive serial/asset redaction rules
Vendor/Project definition of OAM, exact logical positions 0 through 7, physical slot/service-label mapping and approved present/unfitted/unsupported population from the platform recipe
Service-root-discovered complete paginated Chassis collection and target-supported Chassis schema/member-detail access; no assumed OAM member IDs

Per-present-position expected identity matrix: actual resource binding, ChassisType, manufacturer, model, part/SKU/redacted serial or stable token, location, Status.State/Health, PowerState and required Links
Approved representation of unfitted positions, duplicate/extra member policy, WebUI OAM table/detail mapping, freshness tolerance and raw/normalized evidence storage
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify immutable target and discover the complete Chassis collection from the Redfish service root; follow pagination and preserve the redacted raw member list. Do not fabricate `/Chassis/OAM_0` or sibling IDs. Using only the approved vendor topology, bind each actual member to logical OAM_0, OAM_1, OAM_2, OAM_3, OAM_4, OAM_5, OAM_6 or OAM_7 and separately record every position that is expected unfitted/unsupported. For each present member, follow its `@odata.id` and normalize Id/Name, ChassisType, manufacturer/model/part/SKU/redacted serial/asset token, location/service label, Status.State/Health, PowerState and required system/manager/contained-by links. Open the actual WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs OAM chassis table and each present detail view, capture timestamped visual evidence and reconcile every row/field/position with Redfish and the approved matrix. Distinguish absent, unfitted, unsupported, duplicate, extra, omitted, unauthorized and failed reads. Repeat only read-only collection fingerprints. Do not use `curl -k`, process-visible credentials, locator/power/reset/inventory writes or log clearing.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly eight logical positions are accounted with no duplicate mapping: each Project-expected present OAM has one complete schema-valid member whose identity, physical slot, health/state, power and links match the approved topology/BOM and actual WebUI; each expected unfitted/unsupported position has the approved representation and is not confused with an API failure. No unexpected extra member, missing present slot, duplicate position, stale/unknown unexplained state or UI/API discrepancy exists, sensitive values are traceably redacted and pre/post fingerprints prove no change.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires independent OAM_0 through OAM_7 accounting, complete collection/member traversal, unique position-resource binding, actual WebUI visual correlation and exact Project matrix comparison. OAM_0 alone, inferred siblings, three identity fields, a collection count or a generic successful GET cannot pass. Missing/duplicate/extra positions, wrong physical mapping, unexplained absent/unknown/null, UI/API mismatch or incomplete evidence is FAIL or NOT READY by the approved policy. An unfitted/unsupported position is accepted only when the authoritative Project/platform recipe says so; missing topology data is NOT READY, not Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Use only certificate-verified protected GET/read operations discovered from the service root; do not use `curl -k`, expose credentials or synthesize resource IDs.
Keep this case strictly read-only. Never invoke chassis power/reset, indicator, firmware, inventory or hardware actions and never clear logs.
Account for all eight logical indices independently and stop on ambiguous, duplicate or cross-SUT mapping; do not extrapolate one member to any sibling.
Distinguish documented unfitted/unsupported from missing member, omitted response, unauthorized request and transport failure; none may be silently converted to PASS.
Redact serial/asset values while retaining stable tokens, physical slot/service-label identity, timestamps and raw hashes sufficient for audit.
Do not modify physical OAM population or power state to satisfy the expected matrix; record discrepancies for engineer verdict.
expected_evidence: Target BMC/SUT/WebUI/schema identity, trusted session, complete paginated Chassis collection and approved OAM_0~7 present/unfitted topology matrix
Complete raw redacted member response and normalized identity/location/status/power/link record for every present OAM
Eight-position reconciliation with explicit present, documented-unfitted/unsupported, missing, duplicate and extra outcomes
Actual WebUI OAM table/detail visual artifacts with per-position field parity and freshness timestamps
Pre/post read-only fingerprints, preserved audit/log evidence, no mutation and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On wrong target, incomplete pagination, ambiguous/duplicate mapping, credential exposure or UI/API discrepancy, stop collection, preserve/redact evidence and close the session. Do not invent sibling IDs, change OAM population, toggle indicators or power-cycle to repair inventory; obtain the correct vendor topology or Project recipe.

source_conflict.reason: Items explicitly defines the eight OAM positions and Procedure/Criteria consistently request their chassis details. DeepSeek's OAM_0-only shortcut is a review defect, not a Master conflict.

blocked.reason: The read-only multi-member purpose is defined. OAM member IDs, physical mapping and expected fitted population are finite Project readiness inputs.
